name: breach-protocol
description: Peer-to-peer co-op roguelike tactical FPS that runs in the browser. TypeScript (js/*.ts, compiled to dist/js/), Three.js for rendering, WebRTC (via PeerJS) for networking.

scripts.bake:props: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node tools/bake_props.mjs && node tools/bundle_models.mjs
scripts.test:models: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node tools/check_models.mjs --selftest && node tools/check_models.test.mjs && node tools/bundle_models.mjs --check && node tools/bundle_models.test.mjs && node tools/check_authored_golden.mjs && node tools/check_model_cases.mjs --quiet
